people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

translations.web: They came back to him, while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go?’ ”
translations.bsb: When they returned to Elisha, who was staying in Jericho, he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you not to go?”
translations.kjv: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
translations.asv: And they came back to him, while he tarried at Jericho; and he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
